newsitem.title: UK: Mexico 500 bln lire bond due next week -dealers.
newsitem.headline: Mexico 500 bln lire bond due next week -dealers.

text.p: Mexico is expected to issue a 500 billion lire 20-year bond next week, bankers said on Tuesday.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell was tipped as lead manager, but officials there declined to comment.
On Monday, Mexican goverment officials said it could launch a 500 billion lire 20-year bond in the next few weeks.
Mexico's plans to tap the lira sector bring another Latin American sovereign to the list of borrowers waiting to raise funds there.

Later this month Argentina plans to launch a 500 billion lire seven-year bond and in May Brazil is scheduled to bring a 500 billion lire 20-year deal. Deutsche Morgan Grenfell will underwrite both issues.
